**SQL Used**

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xa6d3d.m1_top_zips AS
WITH zip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    COUNT(*) AS trips,
    SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare_raw
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
busiest_hour_cte AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip
                       ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) ASC) AS rn
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
busiest AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip, hour_of_day AS busiest_hour
  FROM busiest_hour_cte
  WHERE rn = 1
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare_raw) AS grand_total FROM zip_stats
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    z.pickup_zip,
    z.trips,
    ROUND(z.total_fare_raw, 2) AS total_fare,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY z.total_fare_raw DESC) AS fare_rank,
    ROUND(
      SUM(z.total_fare_raw) OVER (ORDER BY z.total_fare_raw DESC, z.pickup_zip ASC)
      / t.grand_total * 100,
      2
    ) AS cumulative_share_pct,
    b.busiest_hour
  FROM zip_stats z
  JOIN busiest b ON z.pickup_zip = b.pickup_zip
  CROSS JOIN total_rev t
)
SELECT
  pickup_zip,
  trips,
  total_fare,
  fare_rank,
  cumulative_share_pct,
  busiest_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fare_rank;
```
